Stephanie, thank you for the application. I have read your CV twice, and I have one question.
Of course. Please, go ahead.
You have worked as a trauma surgeon, and now you work with data. Why?
I have always been interested in the decisions behind the treatment, not only in the treatment itself.
That is a good answer. Have you published anything on that?
Not yet. I have started a systematic review, but I have not finished it.
I have seen many doctors make this transition, and most of them come back to the clinic.
I do not know yet if I want to come back. That is exactly why I have applied to your program.
My background is in medicine, and I specialized in trauma surgery.
I have worked in healthcare for more than fifteen years.
I am currently working with data and artificial intelligence.
I have not taken the exam yet, but I have already started the course.
It has been quite a journey.

Hello. My name is Martin Oliveira, and I am a nurse. I have worked in intensive care for eleven years, and I have seen almost everything a hospital can show you. Two years ago something changed. My hospital started a project with a technology company, and they asked me to help. Since then I have been part of the team that designs the software the nurses use. I have not stopped nursing completely. I still work two nights a week, because I do not want to forget what the job feels like. People ask me if I have made the right decision. I think I have. I have found a way to help more patients than I could ever help alone.

Good afternoon. This is a message for all the doctors on the international program. We have received your documents, and we have already reviewed most of them. Three candidates have not sent the language certificate yet, so please check your email today. We have also changed one date: the first online meeting has moved from Tuesday to Thursday, at four in the afternoon, Brazilian time. It has been a long process, and we know that. Thank you for your patience. If you have any questions, write to the program office.
